2604.00830 Meta-TTL: evidence_level improver confirmed under a strict reading of EVIDENCE.md. (1) The edited object is the improver: the meta-prompt φ governs the meta-agent that rewrites the actor prompt between episodes, and that guidance is the only state carried between episodes. (2) Comparable budget: the Naive meta-agent has the same architecture, the same GPT-5 meta-agent and Gemini-3-Flash actor, and the same episode protocol; only φ differs (φ0 vs φ*). (3) More effective subsequent changes: higher W-AUC and average score on whole held-out games/sites/domains (Jericho OOD 0.414 vs 0.286, WebArena OOD 0.766 vs 0.722, τ²-Telecom 0.583 vs 0.433), on held-out instances for WebArena/τ², with an independently meta-trained GLM-5.3-Flash replication. Scope limits are kept: one meta-training run per benchmark, OOD only within each benchmark family, Jericho ID reuses the meta-training games, and φ0 is not disclosed. This is the first improver label in the run; STOP and metaTextGrad were held at retained because they lacked exactly this edited-vs-fixed comparison at comparable budget.
